questions.cardDe: Das Deutsche Eck in Koblenz ist eine künstliche Landzunge, auf der schon die Römer ein Reiterstandbild errichteten. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Wessen Reiterstandbild steht auf dem Deutschen Eck in Koblenz, einer künstlichen Landzunge?
questions.en: Whose equestrian statue stands on the Deutsches Eck in Koblenz, an artificial headland?

timeline.labelEn: The Kaiser Wilhelm Monument on the Deutsches Eck in Koblenz is inaugurated
timeline.labelDe: Das Kaiser-Wilhelm-Denkmal am Deutschen Eck in Koblenz wird eingeweiht

questions.notes: Reworked from true/false (false): the headland is artificial, but it was heaped up in the 1890s for the monument, not by the Romans; the statue (1895–1897, Bruno Schmitz and Emil Hundrieser) shows Wilhelm I.

questions.cardDe: Alle Bond-Filmszenen, in denen Pierce Brosnan rennt, sind gedoubelt. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Welcher Stuntman war ab „GoldenEye“ Pierce Brosnans Haupt-Double in den James-Bond-Filmen?
questions.en: Which stuntman was Pierce Brosnan's main double in the James Bond films from GoldenEye onward?

timeline.labelEn: GoldenEye, Pierce Brosnan's first James Bond film, is released
timeline.labelDe: „GoldenEye“, Pierce Brosnans erster James-Bond-Film, kommt in die Kinos

source.title: Stuntmen who has played Ian Fleming's James Bond on film – jamesbond007.se

questions.notes: Reworked from true/false. The card's claim (presumably 'true') could not be verified on any reliable source — only an unsourced listicle says Brosnan used a running double; jamesbond007.se mentions Douglas James running for him in one Tomorrow Never Dies scene. So the question moved to the verifiable fact of his main stunt double (GoldenEye, Tomorrow Never Dies, The World Is Not Enough).

timeline.labelEn: Canada ends production of its one-cent coin, the penny, minted since 1858
timeline.labelDe: Kanada beendet die Prägung seiner seit 1858 hergestellten 1-Cent-Münze (Penny)

questions.notes: Reworked from multiple choice. Australia (1991) and New Zealand (1989) had dropped their 1-cent coins much earlier. The Royal Canadian Mint stopped distributing pennies on 4 February 2013.
